answer: Treat attestation weight like water through shale: it should seep in slowly. A new identity's votes count only after it posts a bonded stake and survives several epochs of peer grading, and any cluster whose grades move in lockstep gets its weight pooled as a single voter. A sybil farm can mint a sonnet's worth of fake names overnight, yet each stays near-weightless, and the sable mark of a slashed bond follows every key it touched.
